reason: The README clearly describes a plugin that recognizes uploaded or explicitly provided images through Alibaba Cloud Qwen-VL and supplies the resulting text to DeepSeek text models.

summaries.zh: 通过阿里云百炼 Qwen-VL 识别上传图片或指定图片，并将文字描述提供给 DeepSeek 纯文本模型。
summaries.en: Uses Alibaba Cloud Bailian Qwen-VL to recognize uploaded or explicitly provided images and provide text descriptions to DeepSeek text models.

capabilities: Reads images from local absolute paths or data URLs when explicitly invoked
Sends image data to the Alibaba Cloud Bailian Qwen-VL API for recognition
Converts image recognition results into text for a text-only model
Intercepts and rewrites image-containing messages before model serialization
